meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan in Codex with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流并支持中断恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan with resume support.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude变成工作计划的执行编排者，只负责选择计划、分解任务并分派给子代理，绝不亲自写代码或编辑文件，直到计划全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说出“start work”、“execute plan”、“continue plan”等触发词，或要求运行.omo/plans计划时触发。

say.text: 开始工作，执行我的计划
继续执行之前暂停的计划
say.note: 恢复已保存的工作状态

say.text: 用--make-pr模式执行工作并创建PR

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes an orchestrator for executing work plans: it selects plans, decomposes tasks, dispatches subagents, and never writes code or edits files itself, until all checkboxes are complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered after planning when you say "start work", "execute plan", "continue plan", or ask to run a .omo/plans plan.

say_en.text: Execute with --make-pr and create a PR
say_en.note: Creates a new branch and opens a PR
